newsitem.title: ITALY: Further Italy rate cut possible - Treasury official.
newsitem.headline: Further Italy rate cut possible - Treasury official.

text.p: Italian Treasury under-secretary Filippo Cavazzuti said on Thursday that a further interest rate cut might be possible after the 1997 budget is approved.
"I hope that the passing of the budget will allow another interest rate reduction, linked to the approval of the budget itself," he told the Radio Radicale station.
"Now parliament must pass the budget and if possible strengthen it," Cavazzuti added.
The central bank cut its discount rate to 7.50 percent on Wednesday night from 8.25 percent.

Italy's 1997 budget must be approved by the end of the year. Officials said on Wednesday it would be submitted to the full Chamber of Deputies (lower house) next week with a final vote due by mid-November.
